Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul.
你們要讚美耶和華！我的心哪，你要讚美耶和華！
I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
While I have breath I will give praise to the Lord: I will make melody to my God while I have my being.
我一生要讚美耶和華！我還活的時候要歌頌我的神！
Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
Put not your faith in rulers, or in the son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
你們不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人；他一點不能幫助。
When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
Man's breath goes out, he is turned back again to dust; in that day all his purposes come to an end.
他的氣一斷，就歸回塵土；他所打算的，當日就消滅了。
Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,
Happy is the man who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:
以雅各的神為幫助、仰望耶和華─他神的，這人便為有福！
the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He remains faithful forever.
Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things in them; who keeps faith for ever:
耶和華造天、地、海，和其中的萬物；他守誠實，直到永遠。
He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
Who gives their rights to those who are crushed down; and gives food to those who are in need of it: the Lord makes the prisoners free;
他為受屈的伸冤，賜食物與飢餓的。耶和華釋放被囚的；
the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
The Lord makes open the eyes of the blind; the Lord is the lifter up of those who are bent down; the Lord is a lover of the upright;
耶和華開了瞎子的眼睛；耶和華扶起被壓下的人。耶和華喜愛義人。
The LORD protects foreigners; He sustains the fatherless and the widow, but the ways of the wicked He frustrates.
The Lord takes care of those who are in a strange land; he gives help to the widow and to the child who has no father; but he sends destruction on the way of sinners.
耶和華保護寄居的，扶持孤兒和寡婦，卻使惡人的道路彎曲。
The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
The Lord will be King for ever; your God, O Zion, will be King through all generations. Praise be to the Lord.
耶和華要作王，直到永遠！錫安哪，你的神要作王，直到萬代！你們要讚美耶和華！
